Position p = new Position(3, 14);

Reference                  Object
-------------------        ------------------
p ────────────────►        [ Position ]
                           x = 3
                           y = 14

Position autreRef = p;

Reference                  Object
-------------------        ------------------
p ───────┐                 
         ▼                [ Position ]
autreRef ┘                x = 3
                          y = 14

autreRef.moveTo(10, 42);

Reference                  Object
-------------------        ------------------
p ───────┐                 
         ▼                [ Position ]
autreRef ┘                x = 10
                          y = 42
